mapper.select: SELECT NO, EMAIL, NICKNAME, PROFILE, CREATED_AT, STATUS FROM USERS ORDER BY NO DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( EMAIL, NICKNAME, PROFILE, STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{nickname}, #{profile}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'Y'), #{createdAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE NO = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT NO, EMAIL, NICKNAME, PROFILE, CREATED_AT, STATUS FROM USERS WHERE NO = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT F.FAVORITE_ID AS favoriteId, T.CONTENT_ID AS contentId, T.CONTENT_TYPE_ID AS contentTypeId, T.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, CASE T.CONTENT_TYPE_ID WHEN 12 THEN '관광지' WHEN 14 THEN '문화시설' WHEN 15 THEN '행사' WHEN 25 THEN '여행코스' WHEN 28 THEN '레포츠' WHEN 32 THEN '숙소' WHEN 38 THEN '쇼핑' WHEN 39 THEN '식당' ELSE COALESCE(C.NAME, '기타') END AS categoryName, T.TITLE AS title, T.FIRST_IMAGE AS firstImage, T.ADDR1 AS addr1, COALESCE(L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM, T.ADDR1) AS region, F.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM FAVORITE F JOIN TOUR_PLACE T ON F.CONTENT_ID = T.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN CATEGORY C ON T.CATEGORY_ID = C.ID LEFT JOIN LDONG L ON T.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD = L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD WHERE F.USER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY F.CREATED_AT DESC, F.FAVORITE_ID DESC

SELECT R.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, R.CONTENT_ID AS contentId, T.TITLE AS title, R.CONTENT AS content, R.REVIEW_IMAGE AS reviewImage, R.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, R.REVIEW_ACTIVE AS reviewActive FROM REVIEW R JOIN TOUR_PLACE T ON R.CONTENT_ID = T.CONTENT_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{memberId} AND R.REVIEW_ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC, R.REVIEW_ID DESC

SELECT RP.REPORT_ID AS reportId, RV.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, T.CONTENT_ID AS contentId, T.TITLE AS title, RP.REPORT_TYPE AS reportType, RP.REASON AS reason, RP.STATUS AS reportStatus, CASE RP.STATUS WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '접수완료' WHEN 'ACCEPTED' THEN '처리완료' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '신고거절' ELSE '상태확인필요' END AS reportStatusName, RP.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM REPORT RP JOIN REVIEW RV ON RP.REVIEW_ID = RV.REVIEW_ID JOIN TOUR_PLACE T ON RV.CONTENT_ID = T.CONTENT_ID WHERE RP.USER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY RP.CREATED_AT DESC, RP.REPORT_ID DESC

SELECT T.CONTENT_ID AS contentId, T.TITLE AS title, T.CONTENT_TYPE_ID AS contentTypeId, T.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, CASE T.CONTENT_TYPE_ID WHEN 12 THEN '관광지' WHEN 15 THEN '행사' WHEN 32 THEN '숙소' WHEN 39 THEN '식당' ELSE COALESCE(C.NAME, '기타') END AS categoryName, T.FIRST_IMAGE AS firstImage, T.FIRST_IMAGE2 AS firstImage2, T.ADDR1 AS addr1, COALESCE(L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM, T.ADDR1) AS region, T.OVERVIEW AS description, CASE WHEN #{source} = 'ai' THEN '선택한 지역과 여행 조건에 적합한 장소입니다.' ELSE NULL END AS reason FROM TOUR_PLACE T LEFT JOIN CATEGORY C ON T.CATEGORY_ID = C.ID LEFT JOIN LDONG L ON T.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD = L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD
(T.CONTENT_TYPE_ID = 12 OR T.CATEGORY_ID = 1)
(T.CONTENT_TYPE_ID = 15 OR T.CATEGORY_ID = 3)
(T.CONTENT_TYPE_ID = 32 OR T.CATEGORY_ID = 4)
(T.CONTENT_TYPE_ID = 39 OR T.CATEGORY_ID = 2)
AND ( T.TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR T.ADDR1 LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
AND (
L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%') OR T.ADDR1 LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%')
)
AND T.CONTENT_ID NOT IN
#{contentId}
ORDER BY T.VIEW_COUNT DESC, T.TITLE ASC, T.CONTENT_ID DESC
ORDER BY T.TITLE ASC, T.CONTENT_ID DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT ID, USER_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, IS_PUBLIC, STATUS, CREATED_TIME FROM PLANNER WHERE USER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY CREATED_TIME DESC, ID DESC
SELECT ID, USER_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, IS_PUBLIC, STATUS, CREATED_TIME FROM PLANNER WHERE ID = #{plannerId} AND USER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'Y'
SELECT ID, USER_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, IS_PUBLIC, STATUS FROM PLANNER WHERE ID = #{plannerId} AND USER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM FROM PLANNER_REGIONS PR JOIN PLANNER P ON PR.PLANNER_ID = P.ID JOIN LDONG L ON PR.SIGNGU_CD = L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD WHERE P.ID = #{plannerId} AND P.USER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM ASC
SELECT DP.ID AS dayId, DP.DAY AS dayNo FROM DAY_PLAN DP JOIN PLANNER P ON DP.PLANNER_ID = P.ID WHERE P.ID = #{plannerId} AND P.USER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY DP.DAY ASC, DP.ID ASC

SELECT PP.ID AS placePlanId, PP.VISIT_ORDER AS visitOrder, T.CONTENT_ID AS contentId, T.TITLE AS title, T.FIRST_IMAGE AS firstImage, T.FIRST_IMAGE2 AS firstImage2, T.ADDR1 AS addr1, CASE T.CONTENT_TYPE_ID WHEN 12 THEN '관광지' WHEN 15 THEN '행사' WHEN 32 THEN '숙소' WHEN 39 THEN '식당' ELSE COALESCE(C.NAME, '기타') END AS categoryName, COALESCE(L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM, T.ADDR1) AS region, T.MAP_X AS mapX, T.MAP_Y AS mapY, PP.DESCRIPTION AS description FROM PLACE_PLAN PP JOIN TOUR_PLACE T ON PP.CONTENT_ID = T.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN CATEGORY C ON T.CATEGORY_ID = C.ID LEFT JOIN LDONG L ON T.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD = L.L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD WHERE PP.DAY_ID = #{dayId} ORDER BY PP.VISIT_ORDER ASC, PP.ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLANNER ( USER_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, IS_PUBLIC, STATUS ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{isPublic}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{status}, 'Y') )
mapper.update: UPDATE PLANNER SET TITLE = #{planner.title}, DESCRIPTION = #{planner.description}, IS_PUBLIC = COALESCE(#{planner.isPublic}, 'N'), STATUS = COALESCE(#{planner.status}, 'Y') WHERE ID = #{planner.plannerId} AND USER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD FROM LDONG WHERE L_DONG_SIGNGU_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{region}, '%') ORDER BY L_DONG_SIGNGU_CD ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLACE_PLAN ( DAY_ID, VISIT_ORDER, CONTENT_ID, DESCRIPTION ) VALUES ( #{dayId}, #{visitOrder}, #{contentId}, #{description} )
